crossRefs.note: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on…
Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be…
From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine…

translations.web: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
translations.bsb: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.
translations.kjv: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
translations.asv: And he gave them their request, But sent leanness into their soul.
